ASUS Picasso camera calibration EEPROM
=====================================

Required property:
- compatible: "asus,picasso-eeprom", "qcom,eeprom"

These modules return raw calibration through the Qualcomm EEPROM interface.
The ASUS camera HAL requires a DIT template followed by module-specific raw
calibration blocks. The driver assembles that layout in memory using an
allowlisted module ID and read-only factory/golden calibration templates.
Neither EEPROM contents nor calibration files are modified.

All remaining properties follow the Qualcomm camera EEPROM interface.
